f-a11y.1.evidence: Guest, /community/: first Tab lands on 'Skip to content' (href #content, visible at top-left); Enter sets #content; the next Tab lands on 'Community' inside <main id=content>.

f-a11y.2.evidence: bob, Reign, 1440, light and dark (bx-color-mode + prefers-color-scheme): 70 Tab stops on a topic and on the space listing in each scheme, focus ring read 190ms after focus (outline or box-shadow present on every stop). Only exception: the WordPress core admin-bar search input (#adminbar-search, not Jetonomy or Reign). Tab order follows reading order: admin bar, skip link, logo, header menu, community nav, then page content. BuddyX and Twenty Twenty-Five not re-measured.

f-a11y.3.evidence: Icon-only controls have names (Vote up/down, Share, Bookmark, Report, Quote, More options, Notifications, Link, Upload image, Insert emoji, Dark mode toggle) and toggles expose state: Share aria-expanded, Bookmark aria-pressed, votes aria-pressed, theme toggle aria-pressed, notifications aria-expanded, More options aria-haspopup=menu + aria-expanded. BUT the font-size control (.jt-font-scale, role=group 'Font size') has three toggle buttons 'Default/Large/Extra large font size' with NO aria-pressed (checked before and after clicking A++: aria-pressed null on all, the active state is only the class .active), so assistive tech cannot tell which size is selected. Also the Reign header avatar link a.user-link (theme, not Jetonomy) has no accessible name. Pro anonymous toggle not on this stack.

f-a11y.4.evidence: Free surfaces pass: new-topic editor role=textbox aria-multiline aria-labelledby 'Content' label, reply editor role=textbox aria-label 'Reply editor', title input has <label for> 'Title', tags input labelled. Poll option inputs ('Option 1') are a Pro Polls surface and Pro is inactive: needs the combo stack.

f-a11y.5.evidence: Vote controls pass: group role=group labelled by 'Votes:' plus the score element, buttons aria-pressed with labels switching to 'Remove your upvote' / 'Remove your downvote', own content reads 'Score 0. You cannot vote on your own content.'. Reaction chips ('Like, 12 reactions, you reacted') are Pro Reactions: needs the combo stack.

f-a11y.6.evidence: alice on a reply, keyboard: Enter on Report opens role=dialog aria-modal 'Why are you reporting this reply?' with a radiogroup labelled by the title (Spam, Offensive, Off-topic, Harassment, Other), focus lands on the first radio (spam), 14 Tabs all stayed inside the dialog, Escape closed it and focus returned to the Report button.

f-a11y.7.evidence: test_moderator at /community/mod/: Uphold and Dismiss are native buttons whose aria-describedby names the target (jt-flag-8-target = 'Alice Chen'); topic More options menu (Edit, Make Private, Pin to space, Close topic, Move, Merge, Delete) is reachable and operable by keyboard; Delete opens a real role=dialog aria-modal 'Are you sure you want to delete this topic? Cancel Confirm' (no native alert, focus on Cancel). Note: that confirm dialog has no aria-label/aria-labelledby, so it is announced without a name.

f-a11y.8.evidence: Share dropdown: Enter and Space open it (aria-expanded true, focus on 'Copy link'), ArrowDown moves Twitter/X, Facebook, Escape closes and returns focus to Share. Notification panel: Enter and Space open it, focus on 'Mark all read', arrows move through notifications, Escape closes and focus returns to the bell. User menu (Reign header, a.user-link.dropdown-toggle, href javascript:void(0), no aria-expanded or aria-haspopup, no name): Enter opens it but Escape does NOT close it (menu still open after Escape). Origin: theme (Reign), not Jetonomy markup; not re-checked on BuddyX.

f-a11y.9.evidence: Computed contrast (canvas-resolved colours, ancestor backgrounds composited) on topic, space listing, new-topic, announcements space, home and profile pages in light and dark: lowest text ratio 4.51 (Post Reply and Submit buttons, user-panel badge), nothing below 4.5; Closed badge 5.95 light / 5.66 dark, idea pill In Progress 5.8, nav badge 6.29, placeholders 7.7+ dark. The blocked line 'Content hidden because you blocked this user.' is 6.32 light and 7.78 dark. UI-border 3:1 was not measured separately.

f-a11y.10.evidence: 390px: all Jetonomy buttons and menu items are >= 40px high (the only sub-40 buttons are Reign's search icon 15px, dark toggle 32px and search submit 30px); inline text links (author names 22px, permalinks 20px, tags 25px, avatar links 30px) are smaller. 200% zoom emulated at 195 CSS px: scrollWidth 195 == clientWidth 195, no horizontal scroll. Desktop 1440: A++ moves post body 17px -> 19.2px and h1 25.5 -> 28.8px, persists across reload (bn_font_scale=120), while the Reign header (17px) and nav (16px) stay unchanged; control is display:none at 390.

f-a11y.11.evidence: Bookmark toast is a role=status aria-live=polite element ('Bookmarked'); a11y-speak polite and assertive regions exist; submitting a topic without content shows role=alert 'Please add some details before posting.' (id jt-field-error-1) and the editor gets aria-describedby=jt-field-error-1 and aria-invalid=true. Pro-only messages ('Badge awarded.', 'Reaction settings saved.', the poll error) not on this stack.

f-a11y.12.evidence: finn (silenced) on a topic and on /new/: no composer is rendered; the page shows 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.' as plain text in a .jt-notice-warning block in reading order (not colour-only, no role/aria-live needed for static text) and /new/ adds 'Back to Space'.

f-a11y.13.evidence: Topic, profile and space pages: <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> with the current item aria-current=page (topic title, Alice Chen, Feature Requests); exactly one visible h1; heading levels 1,2,3,2.. with no skipped level.

f-a11y.14.evidence: ar locale (dir=rtl), bob, keyboard only: new topic (Tab to title, type Arabic, Tab to editor, type, Tab to Submit Idea, Enter) created the topic; on a topic Tab to Vote up + Enter set aria-pressed true then Enter again took it back; Tab to Report, Enter, ArrowDown to Offensive, Tab to Report, Enter -> toast 'Reported. Thank you.' and the dialog closed; Tab to the reply editor, typed Arabic, Tab to Post Reply, Enter -> reply rendered. Site language restored to en_US.

f-a11y.15.evidence: Free headings checked as bob: Edit Profile page h1 then h2s, profile page h1 then h2s, topic 1,2,3,2 - no skipped level anywhere. The Badges, Profile Details, More about you and Poll sections come from Pro (Badges, Custom Fields, Polls) and are not on this Free stack: needs the combo stack.

f-a11y.16.evidence: Card 10469968030: bob Edit profile > Notification preferences: 19 toggles, every one has a unique accessible name naming type and channel ('Reply to my topic Web', 'Reply to my topic Email', '@Mention Web', 'Badge earned Email', ... and 'Pause all email notifications...'), zero duplicates, zero empty.

f-a11y.17.evidence: Card 10469968030: test_moderator, topic More options: button aria-haspopup=menu; the list is role=menu with only role=menuitem children (7, none without a role); Enter opens, focus moves to first item, ArrowDown walks Make Private, Pin to space, Close topic; Escape closes (aria-expanded false) and focus returns to More options. 'Review in queue' links on /community/mod/ carry aria-describedby, but it points at the flagged content title/excerpt ('Dark mode toggle in user preferences', 'Still waiting on this one...'), not at the space name as the line says; the space is shown in the same row.

runbook_fixes.now: each 'Review in queue' link has aria-describedby naming the flagged content (title/excerpt) it belongs to
